answer_text: The Concierge Desk can arrange taxis for you, sir. It's best to book in advance, especially during weekends and holidays. Fare estimates will be provided before confirming the reservation. You can add the cost to your room bill where applicable.

judge.judge_raw:
CONFLICT: reference says the Concierge Desk can arrange taxis, airport transfers, car rentals, and local sightseeing transportation, candidate says only taxis.
CONFLICT: reference says payment can be made directly to the service provider or added to the room bill, candidate says only that the cost can be added to the room bill.

VERDICT: NO
